The connection you set up (OAuth to Google) and the *tool permission* (letting me actually invoke Gmail tools in this chat) are two different switches. To fix it:

1. Look for a permission prompt/dialog in this session asking about `mcp__claude_ai_Gmail__search_threads` — it may be showing separately from the chat (some clients show it as a banner or require you to scroll/click a pending action).
2. If nothing is showing, check your Claude Code permission settings (`/permissions` or settings.json) — Gmail MCP tools may be explicitly set to "ask" or "deny". You'd need to switch that to "allow" for `mcp__claude_ai_Gmail__*`.
3. Alternatively, just retry your original request ("search Gmail...") — sometimes the prompt only surfaces on a fresh tool-call attempt tied to the current message.

This isn't something I can toggle from my side — it requires action in your client/settings. Want me to try the call again now in case the prompt appears this time?
